result.title: Quantum-Informed Regularized Poisson Learning for Graph-Based Semi-Supervised Classification
result.summary: We introduce IPQSSL, a quantum-informed regularized Poisson framework for graph-based semi-supervised classification under scarce labels. Local graph feature contexts are QR factorized, lifted to unitary encodings, and processed by a shared variational circuit whose measurements yield node wise diagonal weights that stabilize a symmetrized Poisson system. We establish positive definiteness of the symmetrized, regularized operator under explicit spectral conditions and derive a Hermitian, block encoding compatible formulation that separates the classical NISQ oriented implementation from a future fault-tolerant pathway. Across seven benchmarks spanning tabular data and a citation network, the effect of regularization is dataset- and budget-dependent: IPQSSL improves over the Poisson baselines on Iris and Wine at all but the single-label budget, reaching 0.946 accuracy on Iris at ten labels per class and at every budget on German Credit, where, however, all methods remain below the majority class rate. Original Poisson remains preferable on Breast Cancer, Heart Disease, Optdigits, and Cora, with the deficit narrowing as the label budget grows on the two largest graphs. Ablations attribute the gains to diagonal stabilization rather than variational training. The result is a resource transparent bridge between Poisson graph learning and quantum linear algebra, with an explicit empirical delineation of when diagonal regularization helps.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 IPQSSL：对局部图特征做 QR 分解并抬升为单位编码，经共享变分量子电路测量得到节点级对角权重，用于稳定对称化 Poisson 系统，同时给出该算子的正定条件与 Hermitian、块编码兼容形式，并在七个含表格数据与引文网络的基准上考察正则化效果的依赖条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用可训练测量生成节点对角权重以稳定图上的线性传播系统」可供核查是否能迁移为视觉 token 图或证据图上的 latent 状态传播、正则化与数值稳定性设计，但该文本身与视觉多模态推理无直接关联。
